The instant writ petition has been filed with a prayer to quash the First Information Report dated 09.09.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 0204 of 2024 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506,
354Kha IPC, Section 3/4 D.P. Act and Section 4 of Muslim Women Protection of Rights on Marriage Act, 2019 at Police Station - Malwan, District - Fatehpur.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that he does not press the present petition qua petitioner No.1, the husband of the informant/opposite party No.4.
Therefore, petition qua petitioner No.1 is dismissed as withdrawn.

sentences.text: Counsel further submits that petitioner nos.2 to 6 are the family members which includes mother-in-law, brother-in-law, cousin father-in-law, married sister-in-law and brother-in-law (nandoi) and, they have been roped just to put pressure on the entire family.
5. Be that as it may, this petition is disposed of with a direction that till the date the charge-sheet is presented, no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioner nos.2 to 6.
It is also provided that the petitioner Nos.2 to 6 shall fully cooperate in the investigation, failing which, they shall not be entitled to the benefit of this order.
However, it will be open to the Investigating Officer to proceed against petitioner No.1 in accordance with law.
